children: Ciena Corporation (NYSE: CIEN) today announced the launch of Ciena Ventures, a new corporate venture capital (CVC) program designed to complement the company’s organic innovation investments and strategic acquisitions. With an initial commitment of $200 million, Ciena Ventures will invest in early-stage companies and technology-focused venture funds that align with Ciena's strategic focus areas and help advance the future of networking and connectivity in the AI era.

“As technologies such as AI reshape the networking landscape, Ciena Ventures provides another vehicle for executing on our long-term strategy and capital allocation priorities,” said David Rothenstein, Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer, Ciena. “Investing in companies and funds through Ciena Ventures will enable the accelerated development of transformative solutions, strengthen the broader innovation ecosystem, expand our visibility into emerging technologies, and help Ciena to evolve its portfolio, develop new solutions, and pursue opportunities in adjacent markets.”
Led by Loai Louis, Vice President of Corporate Development, Ciena Ventures represents Ciena’s first company-wide CVC initiative and will focus on technologies that:
Enable innovations in optical networking technologies and interconnects
Expand opportunities in adjacent areas such as computing, materials and emerging communications technologies

Through Ciena Ventures, Ciena looks forward to connecting with innovators working on technologies that will shape the future of AI-driven networking and connectivity. Organizations interested in discussing potential opportunities may contact

Ciena is the global leader in high-speed connectivity. We build the world’s most advanced networks to support exponential growth in bandwidth demand. By harnessing the power of our networking systems, interconnects, automation software, and services, Ciena revolutionizes data transmission and network management.
